resources.string: Approximate local wake for read-only analysis/retrieval. Each rule has an editable maximum runtime (initially 120 seconds); expiry requests cancellation and waits for the original executor to exit. Android may interrupt work earlier. Each model request may output up to 2048 tokens. Existing permissions, approvals and capacity apply. Battery restrictions may delay work; reopen after force-stop. Over 15 minutes late is recorded and skipped. Pausing future work does not stop a running attempt.
Action incomplete. Check a positive runtime, future time, zone, session and configuration. A save may already be durable; check the list and reopen before retrying.

A new attempt retains the original occurrence, prompt, session and scope, regardless of the foreground session. Changed configuration, live execution or unresolved effects block retry. Review the original session first.
Choose the result session explicitly (uses its model and workspace)

Workspace: %1$s; tool catalog ceiling: %2$d. Execution uses this session’s then-current history, existing context and read results, sent to the model destination above. Saving locally does not mean local inference. Existing read-only/closed metadata permissions apply; file writes and external side effects are not authorized. Changes to model, destination, workspace, permissions or tool identities require reconfirmation.

Once/daily/weekly/monthly use a fixed zone and original calendar anchor. Short months use month-end, later restoring the original day; DST gaps move forward and overlaps use the earlier offset. Recurrence does not follow completion time.
Waiting for system wake (may be delayed)
Awaiting approval in bound session (counts toward the confirmed runtime budget)
Result or effects unknown; no automatic retry
Confirmed maximum runtime: %1$s seconds; approval waits count toward this budget.
